udacity-ios-app-api: The Udacity iOS App allows users to access Udacity's programming courses from their mobile iOS devices. Using the app, Udacity students can solve programming problems and respond to short quizzes on the go. Classes can be downloaded so that users can still watch them when they don't have internet access.
udacity-android-app: The Udacity Android App allows users to access Udacity's programming courses from their mobile Android devices. Courses are taught by experts from companies like Facebook, Google, and Cloudera and cover programming in HTML, CSS, JavaScript, Python, Java, and other languages. The app allows users to solve programming problems and respond to short quizzes on the go.
cubesensors-app: CubeSensors are devices that contain seven different sensors for detecting air quality, temperature, humidity, noise, light, barometric pressure, and sensor motion in indoor environments. The CubeSensors App allows users to get alerts and recommendations regarding sensor data on their mobile devices. The app is optimized to look good on smartphones, tablets, and web browsers.
algolint: AlgoLint is a web-based tool for writing and practicing algorithms. It has a clean and simple interface that allows users to write code in C/C++, Java, Ruby, and Python. Users can employ code templates to solve problems and save their own templates for use in future problems. AlgoLint can connect with the user's Dropbox account to automatically sync their practice code with their cloud storage.
pop: Pop is a mobile application that allows users to transform their app ideas into a semi-functional prototype using hotspots to link pictures. It is available on multiple platforms, also allowing users to work together remotely on the same project.
best-bitcoin-price: Best Bitcoin Price is a Canadian Bitcoin exchange that helps users find the best available prices for buying and selling Bitcoins. They only work with exchanges that meet their security guidelines and are completely Canadian owned and operated. Best Bitcoin Price searches Bitcoin prices in real time, and all prices are given in Canadian Dollars.
getoutcast: GetOutCast provides users with a customized forecast for the photographic potential for any location in the U.S. GetOutCast uses a mashup of atmospheric and weather data to analyze and get the most probable result. It helps photographers to determine when and where to capture their images.
sush.io: Sush.io is a web application that allows businesses to connect all of their applications together. Sush.io focuses on automation, from automatically adding new contacts to invoicing clients. Sush.io saves businesses time by eliminating repetitive tasks.
mesh: Synced with multiple news sources and platforms, Mesh network provides users with access to a vast amount of news content from around the web that are focused on socio-economic issues.
whatwine: WhatWine is a mobile application that acts as a personal sommelier to those that love to pair wine with their meal. This application helps customers to quickly choose an appropriate type of wine to pair with their meal, turning even the layman into a wine expert.
hyperlapse: Hyperlapse from Instagram is a new app that captures high-quality time lapse videos even while in motion. This application allows customers to capture images and make time-lapse videos that they can share with others on their Instagram feed.
youturn: Similar to Hyperlapse, YouTurn allows users to capture video at specific frame rates ranging from one to five frames per second. This way, users are able to take videos of their drives or road-trips to relive and to share their moments with others. The application compresses the video to decrease file size, making it fast and easy for others to access.
linkedin-pulse: LinkedIn Pulse is a web and mobile application that keep professionals up-to-date with the latest news that is tailored to their profession. It's a place to discover compelling content and discuss what's trending with millions of professionals worldwide. Available on LinkedIn.com, Android, and iOS, Pulse allows users to read and share news wherever they are.
izik: Izik is a mobile application that allows users to search, explore and discover the web in a fun and playful manner. Izik's search results are image-rich. Content on Izik is presented in various categories to allow for minimal typing and to provide context to results. For example, users can look up Jennifer Lopez and see results under the categories of Lyrics, Gossip, and Perfume.
pushpins: Pushpins is a web and mobile application that allows users to search for coupons and save them for their next grocery shopping list, eliminating the need for cutting coupons from newspapers and catalogs. To redeem the coupon, all users have to do is to scan the barcode of the product, and then press tab to redeem. Pushpins is available in over 10,000 grocery and drug stores, and consumes the Yummly API.
myfitnesspal: MyFitnessPal is a health and fitness mobile application available in Apple iTunes and Google Play. At this point in time, the app needs access to contacts, calendar, location, camera, and Wi-Fi information. Once installed, users have to sign up for access. Some of the question asked are related to weight goals, activity track, and personal details with the aim to offer a personalized fitness service.
loseit: Lose It! is a mobile application related to weight loss available on Google Play and Apple iTunes. Besides identity, location, media, and camera, the app also needs access to In-app purchases. Once installed, the app asks for user weight, followed by goal weight, gender, height, and weight plan.
statref-app: STAT!Ref offers healthcare information in desktop and laptop modalities. The organization has released a mobile application that requires an online subscription. In this app, users can find content targeted to academic institutions, healthcare organizations, government, military, and public health.
bizvizz-app: With the BizVizz App, available on Apple iTunes and Google Play, users have access to tax data, jobs data, and other monetary information hidden in regulatory documents as stated in the main page. This app works in the following way: users take the photo of a brand, they compare taxes, and then share data with other members of the BizVizz community. The app is inspired by the movie As Goes Janesville according to the site.
fittap: Designed for those who don't have time or simply don't want to log recurring activities, FitTap is a solution that lets customers log activities such as food & water intake, sleep, and weight changes. Users may do this by scanning custom NFC-tags with their NFC-enabled smartphone. To use this application, customers are required to purchase custom-made tags from the App Store.
sleep-debt: SleepDebt connects with a users' Fitbit to analyze their sleep data. Using this information, SleepDebt will notify a user at what time they should go to sleep. The application connects with FitBit devices.
weightgrapher: Weight can fluctuate depending on a person's activity and diets. It can be hard to predict how the body will react in certain scenarios. Their motto is 'ignore the weight: follow the trend'.
health-month-game: Health Month is a monthly game that is concerned with making small improvements to a person's health, one month at a time. Health Month helps users take the science of nutrition and behavior change to combine it with social gaming tools. Customers get to personalize their own health-improvement rules with this game designed to make workouts fun.
welly: Welly is a mobile application that provides users their very own companion creature that travels with them and tracks their steps with the Fitbit activity monitor. It is an interactive activity game that makes workout simple and fun.
fitdatasync: FitDataSync is a free application that automatically syncs activities from the user's Garmin device with their Fitbit account. digifit: A web and mobile application that gives users insight to their heart, by tracking cardio exercise, daily activities, blood pressure, weight, and sleep patterns. audibase: Audibase is an audio social network. With this application available on iTunes, users can upload, comment, and share in an online community. The app aims to be particularly useful for journalists, coaches, and interviewers because it records until 2 hours of audio material.

mapmyrun: MapMyRun is an application that allows users to track their fitness activities using the built-in GPS of their mobile phones. balance-rewards: Connected with the Walgreens Balance Rewards program, this fitbit application allow users to keep track of their activity to earn Walgreens points. The data on AIDSVu come from the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's (CDC) national HIV surveillance database that is comprised of HIV surveillance reports from state and local health departments. AIDSVu will be updated on an ongoing basis in conjunction with CDC's annual release of HIV surveillance data, as well as new data and additional information as they become available. pinguinale-2006: The Pinguinale 2006 is an event in Wuppertal, Germany, because of the 125 birthday of the Wuppertaler Zoo. Map shows the places of 200 pinguins and photos of them. Firefox works better.
wannadive.net: Worldwide dive site atlas and reference. Hundreds of dive sites from all continents listed. Sites mapped on Google Maps.
ecolocal: Help us build the best source for healthy living and local news by submitting your tips, events and links so that we can all learn to live a more eco-friendly lifestyle.
flickrball: Flickrball is a fun six-degrees-of-separation scavenger-hunt game, using Flickr thumbnails and tags for clues.
amazonhive: Alternative interface into the Amazon catalog. Java applet with price sliders and other filtering tools.
bikely: Discover and share your favorite bicycle routes. Bikely helps cyclists share knowledge of good Australian bicycle routes.
world-cup-roster-maps: View the club teams for players on each of the national team rosters in this summers tournament.
webcottages: WebCottages is a directory of self catering holiday cottages and other self catering holiday accommodation from around the UK.
oregon-wine-explorer: Browse the vineyards of Oregon via this comprehensive map. Search by location, varietal or vineyard amenity.
earth-sandwich: If the earth were a sandwich. Fun way to find the antipodal, oposite side, point for any place on the earth. See them both side-by-side and drag them around. From Ze Frank.
indian-matrimony-maps: Indian bride and groom data from around the World and selected cities in India, via bharatmatrimony.com RSS feeds.
lake-ontario-ports: LakeOntarioPorts.com is a directory of marine destinations on Lake Ontario. Includes boating and sailing destinations.
ecademy-members-google-map: Members of Ecademy.com who allow their street address, postcode or zipcode to be shown publicly are plotted on a Google Map. Work has been done to automatically bunch points when there are too many to display on the map at one time.
mashfot-mashup-about-photography: mashfot is a one-page view about photography. You can find links, news and photos on this site.
realtime-satellite-tracking-map: Very unique mashup that allows you track any of dozens of satellites in realtime as they circle the earth. Watch them move across the top of Google Maps. Lots of peripheral details as well.
following-political-dollars: Useful mashup that lets you see who has been donating money to which political party by zip code. Good combination of raw data, charts and maps. Data source is The Fundrace Project.
priceheat: A one-click price checker. A handy bookmarklet to quickly compare prices for any product. Uses the Amazon API.
zip-code-map-0: Provides detailed map of all US zip codes, powered by google map.
mapcruncher: Very interesting mashup technique from Microsoft Research, MSR. Shows how any type of map image data can be layered on top of a Virtual Earth map. This example with bike trail maps.
notifyr: Subscribe to a Flickr page, getting email notifications whenever you upload new photos.
recent-news-country-map: Map of recent and archival news by country via New York Times RSS feeds and human rghts news by country via hrw.org feeds. Map also includes CIA Factbook data and Flickr images.
bitsoftreats.com: Intelligent agents based marketspace constantly aggregating top deals and rebates for a wide range of products.
mightyv: Explore UK radio and television. Extensive search options. Uses data from BBC Backstage. Data available in multiple formats: RSS, iCal, JSON.
flickr-group-browser: Explore the relationship between Flickr groups and photos with this useful groups browser.
flickrrandom: Multiple ways to browse random images from Flickr: all, interestingness, photostreams, groups, etc.
bbc-programmes-to-ical: Takes a BBC Programme search and converts the results in to iCal format for use in Google Calendar.
daylightmap.com: Excellent visualization of current daylight and nighttime regions around the world. Use the Options bar on the right to tune the settings.
realtime-wifi-map-montreal: Google Maps mashup of the Iles Sans Fil WiFi network in Montreal, Canada. Note: loads slowly.
eventsites: Eventsites allows users to create a mini-website for their event complete with description, a Google Map and photos from Flickr. Eventsites is unusual as a mashup in that the entire site is built using only AJAX and it stores no data of its own.
funbeat: Workout diary and community with integrated Google Maps to let you depict running routes. Account required.
knowcal: UK Local Knowledge - Using data from the directory enquiries database plotted onto a Google Map.
myguestmap: MyGuestmap allows your visitors to add pins to a map showing where they are and leaving a message. Create a map to allow your website visitors to place pins, a bookmark-map where only you can post, password-protected maps, and upload photos.
licketytrip-vacation-rentals: Last-minute vacation rental listings. All properties available in the next two weeks. Browse listings on a Google Map.
webcams.cz: List of webcams in Czech republic.
bed-and-breakfast-hotels-uk: Large UK-based hotel, guest house, bed and breakfast hotelier managed directory.
weathermole: Nice mashup of the NOAA Weather Service API and Google Maps. Enter an address and get detailed forecasts.
jigdo: JigDo combines Google Maps with the most popular trading website in the Netherlands: Marktplaats.nl.
flickrsudoku: Mashup of a popular online sudoku player and Flickr. Sudoku player courtesy sudoku.com.au.
nyc-bike-maps: New York City greenways, bike paths and bike lanes plotted on Google Maps.
real-estate-abc: Comprehensive real estate service: home search, valuation tools, how-to guides, and agent finder.
zillow.com: Sophisticated home valuation tools. 65 million listings. Extensive data on comprables, many search and sort options.
globefeed-maps: Online map application in which you can do a virtual tour of the earth with other online buddies. You can see where they are wandering and have have IM chats with them.
nytimes.com-homicide-map: A map of homicide locations in New York City from 2003-05. Includes date, address, motive, victim description, and suspect description. Published on NYTimes.com on April 28, 2006. Data is from the New York City Police Department.
localerts: Local Alerts, Local News, Yahoo Traffic, Google Maps, NOAA Weather mashup. Alert mashup includes CERT, earthquakes, tsunamis, Avian flu...
world-cup-2006-map-0: FIFA, World Cup Soccer 2006 map. Latest team news via Yahoo FIFA 2006 World Cup Soccer RSS feeds and Goolge News feeds.
myrtle-beach-golf-holiday: Golf course and hotel locator for Myrtle Beach. Good coverage of the area. Warning: loads slowly.
mapgasprices.com: Very good, up-to-date gas price search with Google Maps station display.
iloveinns: iLoveInns is a Bed and Breakfast locator. Search by location or by a region to drill down. It also has gift certificates, a shopping cart, my favorites and other features.
strike-your-google-maps: This creation tool targets those who want to create their Google maps mashups and host the HTML pages on their web servers. You own the files you have created.
apartment-ratings: Apartment rental service with reviews by renters for renters. Search by zip code, see pricing reports, and comparison of ratings on noise, parking, safety, etc.
zooomr: A Flash hybrid of Flickr and Google Maps. Worldwide photos mapped.
supinfo-schools: Showing Supinfo, a graduate school of computer science, in different cities in France, China, Canada and the UK.
live-mapping-2006-nfl-draft: Join MapGameDay.com on April 29th as we live map the NFL Draft. View drafted players by NFL Team, Hometown, and College.
virtual-tourism: Google Maps and Google Video mashup. Select tourist sites from around the world on Google maps and see a video of the location.
panorama-explorer: Tag your photos and place them on the Google Map by uploading them on Panorama Explorer. Search photos by geo data or just exploring the map.
google-maps-meets-stuffopolis: Mashup of Google maps, Amazon and Stuffopolis. Here is a snapshot of where my stuff is around the world right now. Each marker is a friend. Click on a marker and you see what stuff they have.
interactive-census-maps: Area based plots of US Census Bureau data.
google-maps-guide-to-ghostbusters: A mashup of Google Maps and every New York City location used in filming the movie Ghostbusters and its sequel Ghostbusters 2 that a person might be likely to visit on a trip to Manhattan.
my-del.icio.us-recommendation-snippet-0: A recommendation link list generator extracted from site owner's bookmarks archived in del.icio.us. Entire generation process is via client side JavaScript.
my-del.icio.us-recommendation-snippet: My Del.icio.us Recommendation Snippet is a recommendation link list generator extracted from site owners bookmarks archived in del.icio.us. If you tell your del.icio.us ID to the site, you can get the site owner's bookmarks as a recommendation.
stingy-scholar-university-podcasts: This useful mashup helps you find good quality, free online course material from schools worldwide including Harvard and MIT. Both video and audio content available.
zip-code-boundaries: A commercial MySQL database of zip code boundary data. Demo allows entry of a zip code with boundary plotted on a Google Map. Data available for purchase, rates on main page.
routebuilder.org: Make your own directions with Route Builder. Begin by navigating to the start of your route, click a point to start, the click others to get total distance.
freak-streets: Odd and funny street names charted.
billbiter-uk: BillBiter UK is a simple Amazon custom storefront.
map-game-day: MapGameDay.com is a community site that allows fans to create map markers to show popular campus locations and create custom game day maps: ticket locations, parking, tailgate party, stadium photos, etc.
color-fields-colr-pickr: Great way to find Flickr photos by color. Select colors diretly or use the slider to adjust lightness and darkness. By Jim Bumgardner.
50-top-us-medical-schools: Map of the top US medical schools are reported by US News. Pop-up markers show MCAT scores and average tuition.
planet-hazard: Learn about the unknown hazards around you - the toxins you may be breathing. PlanetHazard maps over 86,000 companies throughout the US that emit hazardous air pollutants. Excellent mashup.
pokermashup: See casinos and other places to legally play live poker on a map. Find the closest rooms sorted by distance, get driving directions and the casino web site.
phixr.com: Online image editor with basic editing features and Flickr integration.
us-top-business-schools-map: Top Business Schools in US as reported in US News and World Report: GMAT Score, Avg Tuition, Avg Salary.
featfinder: Explore relationship between artists. Idea based on six degrees theory: no artist is separated from another by more than six other artists. 3rd place winner in Amazon developer contest.
mysic.com: A shopping service that gives a unique view into the Amazon catalog: Line charts show you price and sales rank over time.
bubblr: Fun flickr mashup that lets you add cartoon bubbles to photos.
supervegan: Find vegan restaurants in NYC with this mashup. Markers help differentiate how vegan-friendly each establishment is.
clubfly: Google maps based Gay Bar and Club finder. Great maps markers and customized navigation.
world-port-source: World Port Source provides interactive satellite images, maps and contact information for 645 ports throughout the world.
pacific-northwest-venture-map: Map of Pacific Northwest venture capital funding including Seattle, Portland, etc.
flood-maps: Interesting combination of Google Maps with elevation data to show the impact of rising sea levels. Try it for your own town.
delivr: Fun way to turn Creative Commons licensed pictures from Flickr into digital postcards.
london-tube-journey-planner: Select your starting and ending locations, then this application will show you the tube route.
boston-brunch-map: Browse Boston brunch choices via Google Map.
boston-subway-station-map: Good map of the Boston Subway system with detailed marker popups.
watchthisnext.com: Drag and drop DVDs recommendations. You put them into buckets for those you love, hate, or have not seen. Then based on your choices the site makes recommendations to you.
oishii: Oishii is kind of a del.icio.us mini-zeitgeist. oishii: ephemeral pheromonal del.icio.us-ness. It polls the del.icio.us front page every 5 minutes, and returns all sites bookmarked by at least 30 people.
uk-schools-map: Comprehensive map of UK schools with comparisons of student scores and search capabilities. Marker drill-down brings you to Dept of Education and Skills site details.
trendalicious: trendalicious is a near real-time view of website popularity trends as reflected by the del.icio.us social bookmarking service. All URLs posted by a minimum of two people in past sixty minutes are displayed, ranked by the total number of recent posts.
ncaa-basketball-history-map: NCAA Mens Basketball Championship on Google Maps. Includes locations of Winners, Losers, Venue. History of the Championship games from 1939-Present. Many ways to search and sort including year, highest or lowest Score, nail biters, and widest margin.
vcarious: VCarious is a community-based travel portal. Explore the world via dynamic travel guides, create journals, upload photos, and use other social features.
matchr-flickr-puzzle: Adictive photo puzzle game. Match two pictures that have something in common in the picture. Your goal is to match the photos that have these tags in common. Harder than it seems.
slideroll: Create photo slideshows with music. Site allows you to add Flash to flickr, myspace, xanga, and Blogger
early-gothic-architecture-france: Multple ways of looking at maps, Images, Google Earth KML files for about 1,500 early gothic sites in Northern France, using Google Earth, Google, Wikipedia, Flickr, Clusty, Mapquest. The original data comes from the work of Dr. John James.
jabber-google-map: Shows the positions and status of Jabber - GTalk users and allows personal places to be marked and commented.
nytimes-36hrs-column-map: A Google map that plots The New York Times column 36 Hours. This column offers a weekend-long itineraries different North American cities. Click markers to browse columns from the past 3 years.
waterloo-student-housing-map: Waterloo Student Housing to help college and university students find rental housing and sublets. Combines UW housing database with Google Maps.
vakantieglobe.nl: Nice exploratory interface for finding holiday homes and tourist attractions across Europe.
digilondon: Browse landmarks and other locations in London with this application that combines Google Earth, Google Maps and Wikipedia.
goomaps-radar: Show in real time ultralight aircraft position on google maps, you can also see the cockpit. You can show your plane too.
proper-pint: A site is designed to help anyone thirsty for a proper pint to sort through the many pubs and night-spots of Dublin. Expansive, up-to-date database.
hiking-trail: The Weekend Warrior Hike Finder for Los Angeles and surrounding areas. Warning, can load slowly.
flagr: Bookmark the world from your mobile phone. It is Sharewhere.
packagemapping.com: Track your packages with Google Maps and RSS feeds! Track UPS, FedEx, USPS, and DHL. PackageMapping.com really works and is free to the public. See where your package is as it makes its way across the map. Check it out and bookmark it!
popurls.com: Popular urls to the latest web buzz. Combines over 15 concensus filters into a one-page view. Good looking, Ajax-ish interface. Includes Digg, Flickr, BoingBoing, NewsVine, del.icio.us, Reddit and others.
castingwords.com: Podcast transcript search and transcription service built using the Amazon Mechanical Turk API.
books-price: Compare book prices before you buy with this handy multiple book price comparison service. You can even feed it your wishlist and get comparisons on them all automatically.
tiltomo: Content based visual image search application for Flickr. Look for an image you like, then Find Similar photos either by subject matter mode or color and texture mode.
ibegin-local-search: User driven search where users contribute listings, reviews, pictures, tags, and more. Toronto is first city setup, includes mapped traffic conditions.
where-i-had-my-first-kiss: Share your fondest or worst memories of your first kiss on this community and mapping site. Top level map shows most recently added kiss locations on a world map.
oscars-birthplaces-map: Birth Cities of Oscar winning Best Actors and Actresses mapped out on Google Maps. Covers from 1928 to present.
mobilicio.us: Combines the del.icio.us online bookmarking service with Google Mobile. This allows you to browse through mobilized versions of your del.icio.us bookmarks from your phone browser or other limited-display browsers
pxn8: An online image editor that integrates nicely with Flickr.
amazing-race: Follow the progress of CBS television show The Amazing Race via the Goolge Map mashup.
jacktracker-24: Use this handy Jacktracker mashup to follow the TV show 24. Incorporates images and various plot details. Uses the Wayfaring.com features such as discussion boards for each waypoint.
apprentice-map: The Apprentice on NBC starts a new season this week. This maps shows the hometown of each contestant on Google Maps with their current status of either Active or Fired.
geography-seinfeld: View locations made famous in the Seinfeld sitcom. Includes the Soup Nazi, the Diner, and Nathans Coney Island.
joemap: A do-it-yourself Goolge Maps site. You can create maps, upload photos, add comments and ratings. Explore maps created by other users.
wind-map: Windsurfing and Kitesurfing locations around the world, using a Google Map as the index for a Wiki.
podbop: Slick podcast app that combines band event data from Eventful with MP3 tracks. Type in a city, get MP3s, discover a band you like, and go see them.
tagcloud: TagCloud is an automated Folksonomy tool that searches RSS feeds you specify, extracts keywords and ranks them via font size in a visual cloud.
imapmls: Search through MLS listings in the SF Bay Area via this Google Maps mashup.
nyc-camera-shops: If you ever had problems ordering camera supplies from a vendor in NYC, then this map might be of interest. It plots the locations, along with photos and comments, of dozens of vendors. Not always reputable ones.
digglicious: A cool blend of digg.com and del.ico.us See live updates of what is being dugg and what is being linked.
torino-2006-olympics-venues: See locations of the venues for the 2006 events with good links to details from the official Olympics site. From Remo Madella.
googlecloud: Displays Google search terms in a tag cloud. Uses Yahoo Term Extraction API to group terms together. Greasemonkey script available.
ming-campbell-mp-campaign-map: Maps the speeches, messages of support and upcoming meetings, from www.flocktogether.org.uk, of Ming Campbell MP, candidate to lead the UK Liberal Democrats.
doctor-who-locations: Doctor Who - unlike Star Trek which always used the same rock for its location filming - was surprisingly varied in its choice of quarries. This mashup shows where they are all and includes a kml for Google Earth.
fortune-100-best-companies-map: A Google Map showing the headquarters of the 100 best US companies to work for as ranked by Fortune Magazine. Marker popups give details on each.
seetoronto-virtual-tour: Take full 360 degree photo tours of popular Toronto landmarks like the Air Canada Centre, Rogers Centre, and CBC HQ. Good quality, large images.
geobirds: Sophisticated interface for exploring the birds of North America. Combination of USGS and Audubon Society data. Required Flash 8.
revealicious: A set of graphic visualisations for your del.icio.us account that allow you to browse, search and select tags, as well as viewing posts matching them.
rentalmonster-canada: Canadians, find your ideal urban apartment. Covers most major cities including Toronto, Vancouver, Montreal and Halifax.
live-u-mich-bus-maps: Creative use of GPS, mapping and Ajax technology to show the current location of buses in the University of Michigan area.
worldtrip.tv: Jorg Pfeiffer is on a road trip from Berlin to Southeastern Europe for the German magazine Der Spiegel. Users can post ideas on what topics to cover and places to visit. In German.
flickrscape: Enter a word and watch the flickr photo stream. Click to interrupt stream and try another word.
flickr-album-maker: Use this album maker to build an album and a slideshow of your Flickr photos. It can generate HTML code for you to embed to your blog or web site.
lfvr: A lightweight Flickr viewer. You can search and browse photos by users, contacts, photosets, tags, or groups. If the photo is geotagged, it can also be mapped.
pricenoia: Compares all 6 Amazon international stores, adds shipping to the user country, using user local currency, as updated daily using a webservice, and keeps a price evolution chart.
cloudalicious: This nice graphing application shows you the count of del.icio.us tags applied to a given URL over time. By Terrell Russell.
rent-me-vacation: Worldwide vacation rental listings direct from owners.
scubamap: Wiki and mapping site allowing scuba divers to share their favorite dive sites and advice. Good interface.
hdtv-finder: Use this comprehensive index from HDTV Magazine to find television stations broadcasting in HDTV for all major US markets. Map gives details by station including power information.
blogabond.com: A travel blog where travellers can create blogs about their journeys and map their travels.
flickrfling: Innovative prototype for exploring Flickr photos. Point the application at a feed, like CNN, it then renders the news in photos by matching tagged photos to words from the news.
world-hang-gliding-sites: A Google Maps interface to a database of thousands of hang gliding and paragliding sites around the world, with a feed to show the same in Google Earth.
stuladarshanam: Nearly 200 Hindu temples in America on Google Maps. The site title, Stuladarshanam, means birds eye view in Sanskrit.
chitika: The eMiniMall advertising banners are built on top of the shopping.com APIs.
fxfoto: Windows desktop application for managing photo scrapbooks. With photo service upload capabilities.
starexplorer: Desktop application for managing photos on the Smugmug service.
turnhere.com: The TurnHere video service chronicles different neighborhoods and places across the country through the use of Internet video films. This map plots their locations.
musicmap: musicmap is a visual music search tool for finding the albums similar to the ones you know.
gcdb-game-company-database: If you are interested in the game business, you can use the GCDB searching and mapping tools to find companies near you.
garbagescout: The New York City streets are full of interesting and potentially useful things that have been thrown out. If you see something good, snap a pic, send to GarbageScout where others can go and get it.
world-warcraft-maps: Unusual use of the Google Maps API to control a non-Google map, in this case from the game World of Warcraft. It behaves just a like a Google Map using zoom, pan and drag controls.
fastr: A very fun Flickr game in which you view a set of ten images and try to guess the common tag. Time based scoring.
ipextra.com: A local search mashup using your IP address to attempt to fix your position. Includes info about your IP address.
toronto-live-club-hub: Toronto Live Club Hub helps locals and visitors find out where to find live music in the Toronto area via maps and integrated links to club listings.
mappr: A visually rich interactive Flash tool for exploring place based on the geotagged photos at Flickr. Search by user, tag and collection.
crooked-beat: Find good music and drinks in the NYC and NJ areas with the map that plots data from the Crooked Beat venue and calendar database.
flappr: An nice explorative Flash-based interface into Flickr photos. With tag search, interestingness sorting, user tabs, and related tags.
dcrails: Good interactive map of the Washington DC Metrorail.
pillows-and-pancakes: A guide to Bed and Breakfasts that makes extensive use of Google Maps.
mapulator: See the path of your network connection using traceroute and this mapping tool. Uses Java applet.
podcast-map: View the source location of various podcasts. US and international podcasts listed.
place-mapper: Find drink places in the greater Portland, Oregon and Seattle, Washington areas. Includes good listings of brewpubs and vineyards.
hiking-outpost: Resource for hikers that combines Amazon product data with online resources for camping and trail information.
titlez: Book trends for publishers using the Amazon API. Retrieves current and historic sales rank data for Amazon book titles, displaying trends in graphic and numeric form for each analysis and decision making.
motionmall: Generate money on your website or blog with MotionMall's service. Allows you to customize banner ads for your target audience and displays bestselling products using the Amazon API.
global-surfari: Surf predictions and forecasts for surfing spots across the globe. Use the Google Maps interface to get a surf forecast for a coastal prediction.
mapeire: Map of Ireland with drink prices, parking spaces and petrol prices.
communitywalk: Create your own Google Maps with photos, comments, directions.
flyr: Search Flickr for geotagged photos and then plot them on a Google Map. Nice nested map-within-a-map.
spell-flickr: Type a word or phrase into this fun Flickr application and it will return a set of images spelling-out that word, ransom-note style.
tagnautica: Experimental navigation tool for exploring the space of related Flickr tags. Type in one start tag and dive into tag space. Requires Flash 8.
flickr-related-tag-browser: Nice search and visualization tool that lets you surf Flickr's tag space. Flickr tags are keywords used to classify images. Related tags shown based on clustered usage analysis.
gvisit: Track visitors to your website using Google Maps.
hotels-finder: Find places to stay via this interactive map. Hotels in London, Ireland, Canada and US.
interactive-urinal-map: When you gotta go, but you want to find just the right place, then search here at Urinal.net. Lots of photos in the archive. Both US and international.
shack-prices: Appraise your Seattle-area house by seeing prices of recent home sales plotted on this Google Map.
open-guide-to-boston: A contributor-based wiki for things to do and places to goin and around Boston.
ziprealty: Full MLS real estate listings using Google Maps. As of October 2006 also offers data provided by the Zillow API.
beermapping.com: Maps of breweries and bars across the US. With city-specific maps and directories.
refund-please: Helps shoppers capitalize on price guarantees on recent purchases. Add your purchase information and they will watch for price decreases and automatically notify you if price falls below your purchase price.
nyc-wine-shops: Map of wine shops in New York City. With brief summaries and links to their web sites.
rentslicer: Rental property statistics for major metropolitan areas.
platial: Platial enables people to find, create and use meaningful maps of Places that matter to them.
delancey: This nice del.icio.us enhancement allows you to see which of your del.icio.us bookmarks are used most frequently. By DeWitt Clinton.
exploration-age: Build a Virtual Pin Map of the places you've been.
runway-finder: A flight planning tool for pilots based on Google Maps. Shows airports near your current location, with colour coding for weather conditions reported in METARs, as well as TFR outlines.
goocam: This is a Google map of unprotected/open camera streams obtained from Google searches. The IP addresses for each camera's url has been mapped to its Geo-location. Sometimes loads slowly. Some cams NSFW.
smarkets: A prediction market for Amazon products. Each new product added becomes a stock. If a product's Amazon's sales rank improves, its stock price goes up. And vice-versa. Traders buy, sell, short, and cover.
pumps.ie: Find the best petrol prices in Ireland via this interactive Google Map.
retrievr-search-sketch: retrievr is an experimental service which lets you search and explore in a selection of Flickr images by drawing a rough sketch. Very interesting.
propsmart: A real estate search engine that aggregating nearly a million property listings searchable with a GoogleMap-based visual interface. Site has budding online community of buyers, sellers, and service providers.
nosy-neighbor-map: Washington DC real estate & Google Maps mashup maps vacant property and past property sales. Over 70,000 sales records are accessible. See what your neighbors paid.
us-presidential-birthplaces: For history buffs and school kids, a mashup showing where presidents/first ladies were born. From George Washington through George Bush.
solar-eclipses: This Google Map shows the path of solar eclipses across Earth’s surface. The northern and southern limits of a solar eclipse path are plotted in pink while the central line is blue.
read-all-about-it: Amazon books combined with Windows Live Local. It allows users to find books on Amazon based upon geographical locations around the world.
unesco-world-heritage-sites: 50 random World Heritage Sites on a Google Map. Each time you reload it shows another 50 random sites. With embedded photos and links to details on each site.
london-underground-map: Google Map of the London Underground.
school-performance-maps: School Performance Maps provides a bird's eye view of public school performance in California. Data from California Department of Education, Academic Performance Index. The 1-10 is statewide rank school, low to high.
beer-hunter-canada: Find beer and more with this comprehensive listing and map of retail establishments in Toronto and the rest of Ontario.
bitefinder-uk: UK site with Google Maps to help find dine-in and takeaway food. Menus and readers reviews online to peruse.
cityranks-us-populations: This mashup uses 2000 Census data and Google Maps. Each zip is color coded by population density. Adding a lot of cities to the map makes it resemble election results. There's also a search function to see where your hometown ranks with other cities.
santa-stars: See the location of elaborate Christmas lights displays. Readers can add comments and vote for favorites.
world-volcano-browser: Displays volcanos of the world on a Google Map. Data from the Smithsonian Institution, Global Vulcanism Project
birds-central-park-map: Very nice map featuring locations of photos from the book Birds of Central Park.
nyc-interactive-transit-map: Click on two points on the NYC Google Map and the program will display the shortest subway route between those two points, including walking time.
gothamist-labs-maps: Gothamist Maps are a great way to see what is going on and where right now in NYC.
cityrealty-map-nyc: Apartment listings in NYC with Google Maps.
san-francisco-parking-availability: Real time Google maps of current parking availability in the San Francisco Bay Area.
virtual-nyc-tour: A virtual tour of New York City using AJAX and Google Maps. Navigate through the streets of New York using thousands of pictures, viewing hundreds of descriptions and details on history.
wayfaring: Mapping community site that lets users create and save maps consisting of waypoints and routes.
world-airport-and-airspace-database: Database of over 11,000 airfields and airports across the world, from major internationals like New York, Paris and London to more out-of the way airstrips like Antartica.
runningahead: Online running log service with local search and sharing using Google maps. Running log has nice graphing features.
metro-system-naples-italy: View the lines and stops of the metro system in Naples, Italy.
techrockies.com: Mashup of Google Maps and Rocky Mountain venture capital investments
socaltech-venture-funding-map: Mashup of Google Maps and Southern California high tech and startup venture funding.
uk-pub-crawl-creator: Listing of UK pubs with reviews and ability to have a Google Map generated based a city with starting and ending bars.
maplandia: Comprehensive searchable gazeteer based on Google Maps. Referenc guide has full world coverage.
nuclear-blast-effects-simulator: HYDESim maps the potential effects of radii generated by a ground-level nuclear detonation.
gtalkr: Flash-based interface to Google Talk. Allows you to chat without a client install. Gtalkr also has its own API.
simplest-shop: Uses the Amazon E-Commerce API to create a clean, simple interface to the Amazon catalog.
meteor-impact-craters: Geology.com uses Google Maps satellite images for exploring several of earth's meteor impact craters.
latest-news-india: Mashup of Google Map and Yahoo RSS Feeds
judys-book: View reviews of stores, restaurants, bars and venues placed in context on a Google Map.
simplyhired.com: Job search site that will plot job locations on a Google Map.
geek-shout-map: Google maps and a shout site that has a Roaming geek, find the Geek and shout any message you want on any location on the map.
liveplasma: A visually rich application that combines the Amazon API to show the relationship between movies, bands, actors, etc. You can go straight from interacting to making purchases.
geoworldnews: The latest worldwide stories from the Washington Post plotted on a Google Maps satellite image.
maphistory.org: Google Map of historic locations in US cities. Initially in Philadelphia and Washington D.C.

drinkdeal.com: Use a Google Map to find NYC drink specials by neighborhood and day.
broadwayzone: Sophisticated Broadway show mashup lets you see where shows are playing and has times, pricing, tickets, directions, parking and hotel information.
favorite-run: Map your running routes and where to run.
what-time-it: Find out what time around the world using Google Maps.
esri-shapefile-viewer: Plots shapefiles on Virtual Earth maps.
map-my-run: Allows runners to create and save custom running routes.
google-maps-fast-food: View the locations of over 27,000 major fast food chain restaurants, overlaid on the Google Maps API.
chicago-bike-map: City of Chicago bicycle route data, on Google Maps
earthquakes-week: Google Map of earthquakes worldwide within the past seven days.
folkestone-pubs: If you need a pint in Folkestone UK this Google Map can help you find the right pub.
bush-history-map: See George W's life history plotted on this Google Map.
uk-speed-camera-map: Shows locations of speed traffic camera locations in the UK. As noted on the site: this map is not intended to encourage speeding. Of course not.

bbc-news-map: See where the latest news is happening in the UK.
williamsburger-community-guide: Google Maps mashup helps you find where the hippest hangouts are in Williamsburg Brooklyn.
slice-ny-pizza-map: Links you to pizzeria reviews at America’s Favorite Pizza Weblog. With fun slice-shaped map markers.
nyc-marathon-course: See the course of the 2005 NYC Marathon. From Brian Timoney.
seattle911: See in real time what's going wrong in Seattle with this great mashup of Google Maps and seattle.gov. By John Eberly.

nyc-movies: Lets you see where scenes from famous (and not-so-famous) movies have been shot in NYC.

onnyturf-subway-map: Shows the NYC subway system on a Google Map.
los-taco-trucks-unitos: A Google Map for when you need to find a taco truck in Seattle.

flightwise-formerly-fboweb.com: Lets you search for flights and see the current location plotted on a Google Map.
homepricerecords: Combines home sales data with Google maps.
seattle-real-estate-advisor: Seattle real estate profiles plotted on Google Maps.
send-fax-php: Uses the InterFAX SendfaxEx method to send a binary file such as Microsoft Word or Acrobat PDF to any fax number.
gympost.com: Fitness facility locator that shows gyms, athletic clubs, pilates studios, and other similar places on a Google Map.

toeat.com: Utilizing Google Maps + AJAX + Lots of Restaurants
nanaimo-city-walk: Tour Nanaimo British Columbia with photos plotted on a Google Map.
panoramio: Up to 2 Gb to share geolocated photos.

ufo-maps: Keep up with the lastest UFO sightings with this combination of Google Maps and data from the National UFO Reporting Center.

amazonbox: Display your Amazon wishlist, listmania list or marketplace seller list on your website.
tagzania: Social bookmarking and folksonomies for Google Maps

smugmaps: smugmug photos overlaid on top of Google Maps.
daily-mashup: Combines popular items from Flickr, Del.icio.us, furl, and Yahoo News.

blinksale: Online invoicing service that uses PayPal API.

flickrtivo: Display flickr photos for your Tivo
evmapper: Mashup of EVDB event data and Google Maps, with nice calendar browser for paging through search results.
backpack-widget: Backpack Dashboard Widget for Mac OS X 10.4.
